requests.title: Add support for Oracle Cloud
requests.description: We need to add Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) support to the Cloud Resource Optimizer to provide comprehensive multi-cloud coverage for our enterprise clients.

requests.title: Mobile app for capacity planning
requests.description: Create a mobile application that allows executives to view capacity planning forecasts and receive alerts about potential capacity issues.

requests.title: Integration with Slack for alerts
requests.description: Add Slack integration to the Platform Health Monitor to send alerts directly to engineering channels for faster incident response.

requests.title: New tool: Backup Automation Manager
requests.description: We need a centralized tool to manage backup policies across all our cloud and on-premises environments with automated scheduling and monitoring.

requests.title: Performance benchmarking dashboard
requests.description: Add a performance benchmarking feature to compare deployment times and resource utilization across different environments and regions.

requests.title: Fix: False positive security alerts
requests.description: The Security Compliance Scanner is generating false positives for certain CIS benchmarks that are not applicable to our environment configuration.
